messages.content: Make a video explaining how password reset works in our web app: the user says they forgot their password, the app looks up their account, emails them a one-time link, and the user opens it and chooses a new password.

input.request: Password reset in our web app. The user says they forgot their password and asks the web app for help. The app looks up their account in the users database. The app emails a one-time reset link through the email service. The email is delivered to the user. The user opens the link, which opens a page in the app, and chooses a new password. The app saves the new password and signs the user in.
